description_en: Enables or shuts down an anti-ransomware policy
description_zh: 开启或关闭勒索防护策略
name: ModifyBackupPolicyStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the anti-ransomware policy that you want to enable or shutdown
parameters.help_zh: 要开启或关闭的防护策略的ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the anti-ransomware policy. Valid values:

enabled: Enables the anti-ransomware policy. After the policy is enabled, anti-ransomware can protect your server data by backing up data on specified servers based on your anti-ransomware policy.
disabled: Disables the anti-ransomware policy. After the policy is disabled, running backup tasks are stopped.

Backup tasks consume network bandwidth. Enable the policy during off-peak hours to execute data backup tasks
parameters.help_zh:
设置要启用或停用防护策略。取值：

enabled：启用防护策略。启用策略后，防勒索才能保护您的服务器数据，即根据您的防护策略，备份指定服务器上的数据。
disabled：停用防护策略。停用策略后，正在运行的备份任务将停止。

执行备份任务会占用您的网络带宽，建议您在业务低峰期启用策略，执行数据备份任务
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The version of the policy that you want to enable or disable. Set the value to 2.0.0
parameters.help_zh: 要开启或关闭的策略版本。固定取值：2.0.0，表示要开启或关闭的策略的版本为2.0.0版本
parameters.name: policy_version

schema.description_en: The response parameters for modifying the anti-ransomware policy
schema.description_zh: 修改防勒索防护策略返回数据

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
